Siffrorna är företagens egen bokföring s: The figures are the companies' own books summed after the group's account map. No eliminations have been made yet, and nothing is booked in any of the companies.
En koncern visas när du får se rapporter: A group is shown when you may see reports in all of its companies, or when you have been given the role to read the group's summary. Groups are created under Group structure.
Perioden måste ligga inom ett av moderfö: The period must lie within one of the parent company's fiscal years. A subsidiary's income and expenses count from the day of acquisition until the disposal, and its balance sheet is included if it belongs to the group on the last day of the period. The subsidiary's fiscal year must cover those days, or it is left out.
Den här körningen kan inte visas för den: This run cannot be shown to someone who sees only the group's totals, because it has fewer than two companies, or a company is left out or included for part of the period only.
Beloppen summeras konto för konto över f: The amounts are summed account by account across the companies, which are separate legal persons. A tax receivable in one company can therefore reduce a tax liability in another, and a negative bank balance in one company can reduce another company's cash. In the companies' own accounts such amounts are not set off.
Körningen är preliminär: minst ett av fö: The run is preliminary: at least one of the companies has not locked the period or closed the fiscal year, so the figures may change.
Årets resultat som ännu inte är bokfört: The year's result not yet booked to equity
Årets resultat i balansräkningen skiljer: The year's result in the balance sheet differs by :amount from the period's result above. The difference is the result before the period began, a subsidiary's result before its acquisition and the result of a subsidiary disposed of during the period. The internal report makes no acquisition analysis.
Välj period och Kör konsolidering. Körni: Choose a period and Run consolidation. The run is saved in the run log so that you can see the same figures again.
Varje körning sparas med kontrollsummor: Every run is saved with checksums of what it read and what it worked out. The same inputs always give the same figures. Runs cannot be changed or removed.
Som standard hamnar varje konto på samma: By default every account lands on the same number in the group. Add only the accounts that should land on another group account, within the same account class. A change applies from the next run.
